access.notes: Open-source suite for DFT calculations; the paper used it with GGA PBESol pseudopotentials.
Public repository of crystal structures; the paper retrieved initial structures from here.
Optional tool for special quasirandom structure enumeration; an alternative open-source tool (e.g., pymatgen) is acceptable.
Optional lattice dynamics and energy minimisation code; used in combination with Supercell for SQS selection.
Python materials analysis package; can be used as an alternative for SQS generation.
